intro: Kosovo's greatest sporting successes have come in judo.

chapters.title: Judo
text: At the 2016 Olympics, Kosovo's first, Majlinda Kelmendi won gold in judo; Kosovar judoka won two more golds in 2021.

chapters.title: Football
text: Kosovo joined UEFA and FIFA in 2016. Several stars of Switzerland's national team, such as Granit Xhaka, have Kosovar roots.
